C1611.title: Shenzhen Longhua Police Dismantle a Private Detective Company
C1611.summary: Shenzhen Longhua police dismantled a so-called private detective company and detained 10 suspects. The group allegedly obtained citizens' personal information through illegal channels and offered services such as stalking, surveillance, and marital-affair investigations, exposing risks around offline tracking and misuse of personal data.

references.title: Serving the public: Shenzhen Longhua police dismantle a 'private detective' company, 10 suspects detained
